lines.en: : Just a little further, Sensei. Once we get you into your room, everything will be okay.
lines.zh: : 再走一小会儿，Sensei。等我把你送进房间，一切都会好起来的。

lines.en: : I’m here for you. Just like I’ve always been. And I won’t let anyone ever hurt you again, no matter how much they want to.
lines.zh: : 我在你身边。就像我一直以来那样。而且我不会再让任何人伤害你，不管他们有多想。

lines.en: : Which they do, you know? Everyone always wants to hurt us because they don’t understand our relationship.
lines.zh: : 他们确实想，你知道吗？大家总是想伤害我们，因为他们不理解我们的关系。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay4
: It’s jealousy. How could it be anything but that? Everyone wants what we have, so they go out of their way to try and confuse us.
lines.zh: : 那是嫉妒。除了这个还能是什么？谁都想要我们拥有的东西，所以他们才会不遗余力地来混淆我们。

lines.en: : They want us to believe this isn’t love at all. That it’s something called “circumstance.”
lines.zh: : 他们想让我们相信这根本不是爱。说这是某种叫做「境遇」的东西。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay3
: But such a thing does not exist.
lines.zh: : 但那种东西根本不存在。

lines.en: : God says that everything happens for a reason. So maybe you being hurt right now is what will bring us closer together? Maybe this can be a good thing?
lines.zh: : 上帝说，万事皆有因。所以也许你此刻受到的伤害，正是让我们更靠近彼此的东西？也许这可以变成一件好事？

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay5
: On the bright side, at least Halloween is over now. And the temptation that came with seeing all of those girls in skimpy costumes has vanished just as quickly as candy kept in {b}BUCKETS.{/b}
lines.zh: : 往好处想，至少万圣节已经过去了。看着那些女孩穿着暴露的服装所带来的诱惑，也像装在{b}桶{/b}里的糖果一样迅速消散了。

lines.en: : The pumpkins have all been trashed and are just a day or two away from beginning to rot in landfills across the city while the two of {b}US{/b} return to form.
lines.zh: : 南瓜全被扔掉了，再过一两天就要在全城各地的垃圾填埋场里开始腐烂，而{b}我们两个{/b}则恢复如初。

: While the two of {b}US{/b} return to form.

lines.en: : While the two of {b}US{/b} return to form.
lines.zh: : 而{b}我们两个{/b}则恢复如初。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay3
: While the two of {b}US{/b} return to form.
lines.zh: : 而{b}我们两个{/b}则恢复如初。

lines.en: : But what “form” do you think that is?
lines.zh: : 可你觉得那是什么「形态」呢？

lines.en: : And in the midst of this uncertainty, do you believe you will be able to close your eyes long enough to make out the shape of the proper silhouette?
lines.zh: : 而在这份不确定之中，你相信自己能闭上眼睛足够久，认出那道正确轮廓的形状吗？

lines.en: : What if I told you there was nothing? That this house, this city, and even the ground you walk upon will one day vanish like the girl you used to love?
lines.zh: : 如果我告诉你什么都没有呢？这栋房子、这座城市，甚至你脚下的土地，总有一天都会像你曾经爱过的那个女孩一样消失？

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay7
: Or what if it already has?
lines.zh: : 或者，万一它已经消失了呢？

lines.en: : What if the world you see is only being seen because you want to see it and what there actually is to see is never seen at all because you’re seeing something seemingly unseen?
lines.zh: : 万一你看见的世界，只是因为你想看见它才被看见，而真正可看的从来没有被看见，因为你在看着某个看似不可见的东西？

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay8
: You could always reload an earlier save.
lines.zh: : 你随时可以读取一个更早的存档。

lines.en: : You could go back to {b}A TIME WHEN THINGS WERE HAPPIER{/b} and slowly saunter through those SENSEI-tional sexcapades until your manhood is reduced to pulp.
lines.zh: : 你可以回到{b}一个更幸福的时光{/b}，慢慢徜徉在那些「老师级」的性爱冒险里，直到你那话儿被榨成一摊烂泥。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay9
: But if this game is not a game like the game-master says, and you do game-like things that result in a “game over” will you {s}game{/s} gain anything at all?
lines.zh: : 可如果正如游戏大师所说，这游戏并不是游戏，而你做了那些游戏般的事、导致「游戏结束」，你究竟能得到什么？

lines.en: : Are you just killing time when it all comes down to it? Shirking responsibilities and stretching out those tiny hands of yours in an attempt to reach a {b}FEELING{/b} you’ve been chasing your whole life?
lines.zh: : 说到底，你只是在打发时间吗？逃避责任，伸出你那双小手，试图够到你追了一辈子的某种{b}感觉{/b}？

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay10
: Are you close?
lines.zh: : 你快到了吗？

lines.en: : Are you going to cum?
lines.zh: : 你要射了吗？

lines.en: : Are you going to cry?
lines.zh: : 你要哭了吗？

lines.en: : Are you going to {b}CRY,{/i} you little bitch? Are you going to {b}FUCKING CRY?!{/b}
lines.zh: : 你要{b}哭{/b}了，你这小贱货？你要{b}他妈的哭了吗？！{/b}

lines.en: : {b}MEN DON’T CRY. MEN ARE STRONG. FEELINGS ARE FOR FUCKING GIRLS. YOU SHOULD BE {i}FUCKING GIRLS.{/i} {/b}
lines.zh: : {b}男人不哭。男人很强。感情是给该死的女人的。你该去操{i}那些该死的女人{/i}。{/b}

lines.en: : {b}YOU’RE NOT A FUCKING PUSSY, ARE YOU? {i}ARE YOU?!{/i} STOP WHINING AND GO FUCK SOME GIRLS.{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}你不是个该死的孬种，对吧？{i}是吗？！{/i}别再抱怨了，去操几个女生。{/b}

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay2
: You poor thing. You must be tired after all you went through.
lines.zh: : 可怜的家伙。经历了那么多，你一定累了吧。

lines.en: : But that’s okay. You’re back now. {i}I’m{/i} back now. And everything you saw was only a dream.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系。你回来了。{i}我{/i}也回来了。而你所看到的一切，只不过是一场梦。

lines.en: : But this? This is real, Sensei. {i}I’m{/i} real. Even if the house and the floor and the city all disappear, I won’t. And that’s a promise. A promise I’d only make to {i}you{/i} because {i}you’re{/i} special.
lines.zh: : 但此刻是真的，Sensei。{i}我{/i}是真的。就算房子、地板、整座城市都消失，我也不会。这是承诺。一个我只对{i}你{/i}许下的承诺，因为{i}你{/i}是特别的。

lines.en: : And anyone who tells you otherwise is lying.
lines.zh: : 而任何对你说不是的人，都在撒谎。

lines.en: : Who are you going to trust? Them? Or me?
lines.zh: : 你要相信谁？他们？还是我？

: Ami.
lines.zh: : Ami。

lines.en: : Yes, [amimaster]?
lines.zh: : 在，[amimaster]？

lines.en: : Fetch me my sanity-pack.
lines.zh: : 去把我的理智补给包拿来。

lines.en: : Yes, [amimaster].
lines.zh: : 好的，[amimaster]。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay10
scene wearehomenowyay13
: Here you go, [amimaster]! These items will help keep you sane while you’re locked in here indefinitely.
lines.zh: : 给您，[amimaster]！这些东西能帮你在被无限期关在这里的日子里保持理智。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay14
: Feel free to relieve yourself in the bucket and I’ll empty it out every hour on the hour.
lines.zh: : 你可以随时在桶里解决生理需求，我会在每个整点来倒一次。

lines.en: if amifingered == True:
: I also brought you a towel and an onahole to take care of your more carnal desires whenever I’m away from the house. But I promise I’ll stay here as much as possible.
lines.zh: : 我还给你带了条毛巾和一个自慰杯，好在我出门的时候照顾你那些更肉体化的欲望。不过我保证会尽量待在这儿陪你。

lines.en: else:
: I also brought you a towel and an onahole to take care of your more carnal desires if you’re still opposed to fucking me like you’re supposed to.
lines.zh: : 我还给你带了条毛巾和一个自慰杯，好在你仍然不肯履行本分操我的时候，照顾你那些更肉体化的欲望。

lines.en: : Why the long face, [amimaster]?
lines.zh: : 怎么愁眉苦脸的，[amimaster]？

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay15
: Wow, you must be in a {i}really{/i} bad spot if you’re not even going to respond on auto-pilot.
lines.zh: : 哇，你连在自动驾驶状态下都不肯回应，看来情况{i}真的{/i}很糟。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay16
: That’s okay, though! I’ve been waiting for an opportunity to do this again for a really long time now and I’ll be sure to make the best of it no matter {i}what{/i} condition you’re in!
lines.zh: : 不过没关系！我等这样一个机会已经等了很久很久，不管你是{i}什么{/i}状态，我一定会好好把握的！

lines.en: : I’m so excited, [amimaster]! Just think of all the uninterrupted time we’ll get to spend together now!
lines.zh: : 我好兴奋啊，[amimaster]！想想看，现在我们有大把不受打扰的时间可以待在一起了！

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay17
: We can watch movies and cuddle and play video games and cuddle and eat lots of food and cuddle and take baths together and cuddle and you can even get me pregnant if you want!
lines.zh: : 我们可以看电影、抱抱、打游戏、抱抱、吃好多东西、抱抱、一起洗澡、抱抱，你要愿意的话，甚至还能让我怀孕！

lines.en: : That sounds fun, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 听起来很有趣，对吧？

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay16
: Teehee! No, {i}you’re{/i} the cutest thing in the whole wide world!
lines.zh: : 嘻嘻！不，{i}你{/i}才是全世界最可爱的东西！

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay18
: That reminds me, though — you have a lot more {i}acquaintances{/i} now than you had the last time you were broken. And stopping them all from trying to see you sounds like a pain.
lines.zh: : 不过这提醒我了——比起上次你崩溃的时候，你现在多了好多「{i}熟人{/i}」。而要把他们全都拦住不让他们见你，听起来就挺麻烦的。

lines.en: : I’ll have to put bars on your window. And install some extra locks on your door so it’s harder for people to break in.
lines.zh: : 我得给你的窗户装上护栏。再给你的门多装几把锁，让别人更难闯进来。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay19
: Maybe I can find some security cameras online too? Those will probably help, I think. Especially with all those apps that let you monitor them from your phone nowadays.
lines.zh: : 也许我还能在网上找些监控摄像头？我觉得那些应该会有用。尤其是现在还有那种能在手机上查看的应用。

lines.en: : Oh, and I can’t forget about the attic and your secret hiding place either. Gosh, I’ve got my work cut out for me, don’t I?
lines.zh: : 哦，阁楼和你那个秘密藏身处也不能忘。天哪，我的活儿可不少，对吧？

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay20
: But you’ll help me, won’t you [amimaster]?!
lines.zh: : 不过你会帮我的，对吧，[amimaster]？！

lines.en: : I know it’s probably asking a lot of you right now, but I promise it won’t take much time at all! And it’ll keep you safe and happy, so it’ll be a worthwhile investment for sure!
lines.zh: : 我知道现在对你要求可能有点多，但我保证要不了多少时间！而且它能让你安全又幸福，所以绝对是值得的投入！

lines.en: : I just need you to trust me completely and entirely because only I know what’s good for you and everyone else is an enemy! Okay?!
lines.zh: : 我只需要你完完全全地信任我，因为只有我知道什么对你有好处，其他人全是敌人！好吗？！

lines.en: : Great!
lines.zh: : 太好了！

lines.en: : Then, I’ll be taking your phone now.
lines.zh: : 那么，现在我要没收你的手机了。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay21
: Yay! Now, you’re totally cut off from everyone who isn’t named Ami Arakawa and you don’t need to worry about responding to anyone’s messages while you’re grieving!
lines.zh: : 耶！现在你和除了 Ami Arakawa 之外的所有人彻底断联了，你在悲伤期间也不用操心回复任何人的消息！

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay22
: I’ll handle all of that for you! And I’ll also tell everybody that you want them to leave you alone for the indefinite future since you’re going to be here with me! Sound good?!
lines.zh: : 那些事我全包了！而且我还会告诉所有人，你希望他们在可预见的未来里都别来烦你，因为你会在这儿陪我！听起来不错吧？！

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay23
: Really?! You mean that?!
lines.zh: : 真的？！你说真的？！

lines.en: : Yeah! Of course I’m excited too!
lines.zh: : 当然！我也一样兴奋！

lines.en: scene black
: {b}I’ll get started right away!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}我这就开始！{/b}

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay24

: So...is there a {i}reason{/i} the two of you have been creepily staring at me for the last ten minutes? Because if you’ve got some kind of bad news to break to me or something, please just tell me now.
lines.zh: : 那么……你们俩过去十分钟一直阴森森地盯着我，有什么{i}理由{/i}吗？如果你们有什么坏消息要告诉我什么的，现在就说吧。

lines.en: : Maya...do you...
lines.zh: : Maya……你……

lines.en: : Do you remember...{i}anything?{/i} About me? Or...Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 你还记得……{i}什么{/i}吗？关于我？或者……Sensei？……

lines.en: : What the fuck are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在说什么？

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay25
: Hah...
: What Ayane means to say is — for the first time ever, you didn’t make it to the rooftop for an apparent apocalypse and-
lines.zh: : Ayane 想说的是——有史以来第一次，你没能在一场显而易见的末日时赶到天台，而且——

lines.en: : Yeah, instead of just making up ridiculous stories, why not let Ayane explain what she means so I don’t wind up with an even bigger headache than I already have? Thanks.
lines.zh: : 是啊，与其编这种荒唐的故事，不如让 Ayane 直接解释她是什么意思，免得我的头比我现在的还要痛。谢了。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay26
: Ugh...forget it. I barely even know what’s going on here in the first place.
lines.zh: : 呃……算了。我压根就不太清楚这儿到底怎么回事。

lines.en: : Maya...how do you feel about Sensei?
lines.zh: : Maya……你对 Sensei 是什么感觉？

lines.en: : Bad. Why?
lines.zh: : 很差。怎么了？

lines.en: : How do you feel about {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那对{i}我{/i}呢？

lines.en: : Slightly...better? But again, {i}why?{/i}
lines.zh: : 稍微……好一点？不过再问一次，{i}为什么{/i}？

lines.en: : Last question — how do you feel about the three of us starting a time traveling club that meets once every several months on top of the school rooftop?
lines.zh: : 最后一个问题——你觉得我们三个成立一个「时间旅行社」，每隔几个月在学校天台上聚一次，怎么样？

lines.en: : Like that’s the most ridiculous idea for a club that I have ever heard and that you’re going to need a much better sales pitch if you want to actually recruit anyone.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这是我听过最荒唐的社团点子，你要真想招人，得拿出比这更好的说辞。

lines.en: : Besides, I’m already in the manga club and-
lines.zh: : 再说，我已经在漫画社了，而且——

lines.en: : Maya...listen to me. Your memories have been manipulated.
lines.zh: : Maya……听我说。你的记忆被人动过手脚。

lines.en: : Excuse me?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Up until an hour ago, you were caught in a timeloop with Sensei and I that you’d been personally stuck in for so long that you stopped keeping track.
lines.zh: : 直到一小时前，你还和 Sensei 和我一起困在一个时间循环里——你个人被困在里面太久，久到你已经不再计数了。

lines.en: : You should have opened with that before telling me what your weird club was about. That’s a much better pitch.
lines.zh: : 你该先说这个，再告诉我你那个奇怪的社团是干嘛的。这样招人效果好多了。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay27
: Maya, it’s not a pitch! I’m being serious! And it’s taking all I have to not start crying right now, so please at least try and be a little more considerate!
lines.zh: : Maya，这不是说辞！我是认真的！而且我现在得使出全力才能不掉眼泪，所以拜托你至少体谅一点！

lines.en: : Fine. Sorry. I will stand here, waiting with bated-breath, as you rewrite my backstory right in front of me. Please proceed.
lines.zh: : 好吧。抱歉。我会屏息站在这儿，任你当着我的面重写我的人生背景。请继续。

lines.en: : She {i}does{/i} seem a little...{i}sassier{/i} than normal, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 她看起来{i}确实{/i}比平时……{i}更冲一点{/i}，对吧？

lines.en: : I was never {i}close{/i} with Maya by any means, but I’d be lying if I said I thought that this one and the one I knew a week ago were the same person based on attitude alone.
lines.zh: : 我跟 Maya 无论如何都算不上{i}亲近{/i}，但如果说仅凭态度我就觉得眼前这个和我一周前认识的是同一个人，那我是在撒谎。

lines.en: : Question — am I invisible too? Or is Makoto just a bitch?
lines.zh: : 问一句——我也隐身了吗？还是说 Makoto 就是个贱人？

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay28
: I suppose I’m a bit of a bitch.
lines.zh: : 我想我确实有点贱。

lines.en: : Maya, I get that this sounds completely ridiculous. Even {i}I{/i} have a hard time accepting any of it and I’ve lived through a handful of apocalypses now — but you have to believe me.
lines.zh: : Maya，我知道这听起来荒唐透顶。连{i}我自己{/i}都很难接受，而我可是亲身经历过好几场末日了——但你必须相信我。

lines.en: : You just had your mind reset after maybe thousands or...millions of years of being trapped in high school. {i}That’s{/i} why Sensei seemed so...broken just now...He misses you. He wants the old Maya back.
lines.zh: : 你刚刚经历了一次心智重置——在此之前，你被困在高中里，也许几千年……甚至几百万年。那{i}就是{/i} Sensei 刚才看起来那么……崩溃的原因……他想你。他想要以前那个 Maya 回来。

lines.en: : Sorry, but are you implying right now that he and I were somehow romantically involved with one another?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你这是不是在暗示，他和我之间曾经有过什么恋爱关系？

lines.en: : Yes. That is exactly what I’m implying. And it wasn’t just “involved.” You {i}loved{/i} each other. And you probably still do now, but...I don’t really understand all of the details about your...{i}relationship.{/i}
lines.zh: : 对。我暗示的正是这个。而且不只是「有过关系」。你们曾经{i}相爱{/i}。也许现在也还爱着，只是……我不太了解你们那段「{i}关系{/i}」的全部细节。

lines.en: : So...now that I’m no longer trapped in this apparent timeloop, the version of me he loved no longer exists? Which has forced him into whatever that catatonic state from earlier was?
lines.zh: : 所以……既然我不再困在这个所谓的时间循环里，他爱的那个版本的我就不复存在了？这才让他陷入刚才那种紧张性木僵的状态？

lines.en: : It seems that way. But again-
lines.zh: : 看起来是这样。不过再说——

lines.en: : Shut up, Makoto. I’m talking to Ayane right now.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Makoto。我现在在跟 Ayane 说话。

lines.en: scene wearehomenowyay29
: Wow. Now {i}I{/i} want the old one back as well.
lines.zh: : 哇。现在连{i}我{/i}也想要以前那个回来了。

lines.en: : Yes, Maya. You were a major part of Sensei’s life. {i}Mine{/i} too. And the fact that you’re essentially a completely different person all of a sudden is like...it’s like we lost a loved one. Out of {i}nowhere.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是的，Maya。你曾是 Sensei 生命里重要的一部分。也是{i}我的{/i}。而你突然之间变成了完全不同的人，就像……就像我们失去了一位至亲。{i}毫无征兆地{/i}。

lines.en: : It hurts.
lines.zh: : 很痛。

lines.en: : Sure...but, on the other hand, I can’t imagine there is {i}any{/i} version of me that would have been happy to be caught up in a perpetual timeloop. That sounds fucking horrible.
lines.zh: : 当然……可另一方面，我想象不出任何一个版本的我，会乐意被困在永恒的时间循环里。那听起来他妈的可怕。

lines.en: : So if any of this is true, which it’s not, shouldn’t you be {i}celebrating{/i} that I’ve somehow managed to escape such a terrible fate?
lines.zh: : 所以如果这些都是真的（当然不是），你们难道不该{i}庆祝{/i}我 somehow 逃过了那样可怕的命运吗？

lines.en: : Specifically a fate where I am somehow romantically involved with our teacher — a thing that has definitely never happened before and will never happen ever because ew.
lines.zh: : 具体来说，是一个我和我们的老师谈恋爱的命运——这种事绝对从没发生过，也永远不会发生，因为恶心。

lines.en: : I sense a bit of deceit in those words, New-Maya.
lines.zh: : 我在这话里嗅到了一丝口是心非，新版 Maya。

lines.en: : And I sense a bit of jealousy in those ones, Bitch-Makoto.
lines.zh: : 而我在那些话里嗅到了一丝嫉妒，贱人 Makoto。

lines.en: : Can you at least...try talking to Sensei about it? It can either be alone or...with me. I don’t care. I just can’t bear to see him like that, Maya. And if you really do care for him, I’m sure you feel the same.
lines.zh: : 你至少……能试着跟 Sensei 谈谈这件事吗？可以是单独谈，或者……和我一起。我不在乎。我只是不忍心看他那样，Maya。如果你真的在乎他，我相信你也会有同感。

lines.en: : I {i}don’t{/i} care for him and I {i}don’t{/i} feel the same, but...for the sake of getting you to stop spouting nonsense at me, fine. I’ll {i}talk{/i} to him.
lines.zh: : 我不在乎他，也没有同感，不过……为了让你别再对着我胡说八道，行吧。我会跟他{i}谈{/i}。

lines.en: : But don’t say I’ve never done anything for you after this because I {i}hate{/i} talking. Feelings are stupid and people are stupid for having them.
lines.zh: : 但在这之后别说我从没为你做过什么，因为我{i}讨厌{/i}说话。感情是蠢东西，怀有感情的人也蠢。

lines.en: : Thank you...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你……

lines.en: : I guess all that’s left now is waiting until the next time we see him.
lines.zh: : 我想现在剩下的，就是等下次见到他了。

lines.en: scene black
: You say that as if we won’t be seeing him tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 你这话说得好像我们明天见不到他似的。
